description: This file defines the EndpointResourceResult class, which extends AbstractEndpointResult and provides a normalization method used within the OrangeHRM Core API v2. It appears to be part of the API response serialization mechanism, encapsulating the result of an endpoint resource operation.

classes.name: EndpointResourceResult
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractEndpointResult to represent the result of an API endpoint resource, with a normalize method.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized array representation of the endpoint result, utilizing the normalizeObject method.
